lessons.title: Small steps, real savings
lessons.body: Skipping a purchase creates an opportunity to save. Recording money actually set aside adds confirmed savings.
lessons.question: Which action adds confirmed savings?
lessons.feedback: Confirmed savings track money you report actually setting aside; skipped purchases stay potential savings.

lessons.title: Your spending target
lessons.body: A budget is a target you choose. Without a configured limit, spending cannot be described as under budget.
lessons.question: What is needed to say spending is within a daily target?

options.label: A configured daily limit and recorded spending

lessons.feedback: Compare recorded spending with a configured daily limit; an absent limit is not zero.
